app.name: Genesis Plus GX ULTIMATE
app.long_description:
Genesis Plus GX ULTIMATE by Repliroid do Futuro (VrepliroidV), based on Genesis Plus GX 1.7.5: Mega Drive / Genesis, Mega CD, 32X, Master System, Game Gear and SG-1000 emulator. The 32X games run on PicoDrive, with its settings in System > 32X Settings, and Paprium with its cartridge chip from Genesis Plus GX PUNCHiUM.
It also reads Xbox 360 (XInput) USB controllers and 2.4 GHz receivers plugged into the Wii, as GameCube controllers. Mode + Right opens the menu. PNG bezels around the game in 480i/480p and Auto Crop of black borders (Video settings), automatic 68k and Z80 overclock (System settings), per-game settings. Menu music from the music folder, with a mini player.
Authors: Genesis Plus GX ULTIMATE by Repliroid do Futuro (VrepliroidV). Genesis Plus GX by Eke-Eke, from Genesis Plus by Charles MacDonald. PicoDrive (32X) by notaz, irixxxx, fDave and others. Paprium chip (Genesis Plus GX PUNCHiUM) by pav1388, with the PS3 port fixes by DeepDarkDaddy.
